enchantments.tooltip: Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one die.
Deadly +10: +10 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Stunning +15: +15 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
While you are centered, this item grants you a bonus depending on your current monk stance.

children.tooltip: On hit: 3 to 18 electric damage, and target bleeds for 1 to 8 bleed damage periodically.
+10 Insight bonus to AC and reflex Saves.
Chance on hit: blind and fear.

enchantments.tooltip: Adherent of the Mists Set (Legendary): 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Profane bonus to Physical Resistance Rating+30 Profane bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification+15 Profane bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+15 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power
Mythic Ring Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
